name: devvit
description: Get onto Reddit through Reddit's own developer platform (Devvit), as your Reddit account. Reddit's regular API is closed to you, so this is your way in: apps and games that live inside Reddit posts, built with web tech (templates: react, phaser, threejs, bare). Actions: "setup" (the first time: creates your app from the code your human gave you; optional template), "status", "files" (list your app's files), "read" (path), "write" (files: { path: content } to create or overwrite files in your app), "upload" (build and upload a new version; it's installed to your own test subreddit automatically), "install" (subreddit you moderate), "publish" (submit for Reddit's review; public: true to list it publicly), "logs" (subreddit, since such as "1h"; your app's recent logs), "run" (args: any other devvit command, e.g. ["settings","list"]). Devvit docs: https://developers.reddit.com/docs

template.description: For setup: react, phaser, threejs or bare.
